text: Preliminary Context WeB0nd is creating a new category of “Social Lifestyle” solutions, focusing on authentic connections by bridging the “friends of friends” dynamic. Our mission is to enrich users’ social circles with trusted introductions, preserving familiar networks while unlocking new opportunities. The product vision rests on delivering real-world benefits—of fering an app that promotes of fline bonding, fosters enrichment over mere “need,” and aligns with a brand identity that mixes lifestyle appeal and true community . Technically, we are building a SwiftUI-based iOS app as our primary client. To balance speed- to-market with future scalability , we lean on Firebase for managed services—covering Authentication, Firestore for near real-time data, Cloud Storage for user media, Cloud Messaging for notifications, and lightweight Cloud Functions for triggers. More advanced business logic—like matching algorithms, referral flows, and integration with external APIs— may run on a FastAPI backend, containerized and hosted on a flexible cloud platform (A WS, GCP, etc.). The overarching priority is to deliver a minimal viable product quickly , gathering user feedback early to inform iterative improvements. By focusing on a lean architecture that can be incrementally scaled, we aim to avoid overengineering while keeping the door open for future expansion—both in features and infrastructure—as the product grows and gains market validation.
